=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:341-343 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The second follow-up guard runs only when `PR_CHECKS_WAIT_WAITED_S > 0`. `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:711` leaves that value at 0 when the required checks are already settled, so the recheck before `gh pr merge --auto` (line 385 or 436) is skipped on that path.
  WHY: A `status=clean` marker posted on the parent head between the first guard (line 285) and the merge call goes unseen, and the follow-up PR can merge into the clean-audited head (the PR #9356 failure mode). All four flagging reviewers rated this MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagreed and did not adopt it: in its view the window is only a few API calls and no wider than the gap that always remains after the second guard.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:835-844 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED` kill switch in `single_pass_followup_merge_guard` (line 841 treats only a literal `false` as disabled) never reaches the guard. Neither the "Enable auto-merge on PR" step (`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4418-4432`) nor `run_security_followup_guard` (`scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:272-273`) passes it, and the gate at line 458 reads the same variable the opposite way (unset or empty means off).
  WHY: In repos where the pass is off, stacked PRs still make the pulls, `gh api user` and comments lookups. Any transient failure returns `unverifiable`, which logs `reason=security_followup_guard_unverifiable` and withholds auto-merge. All three rated it NIT, because keeping "unset = on" was a deliberate fail-safe.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:927-951 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hold-comment dedupe in `single_pass_followup_merge_guard` matches the marker only when it is the last non-empty line of a comment (`| last // "" | ... | select(. == $m)`). After a later comment lands on the PR, it counts 0 and posts the hold comment again.
  WHY: Repeated review rounds on a refused follow-up PR pile up duplicate hold comments. This is comment noise only, and the refuse outcome is unaffected (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither the PR DIFF nor the LAST RUN DIFF touches .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, and grep finds no `followup-guard` call in it. The deterministic-skip path goes `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` -> `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` -> `gh_retry gh pr merge --squash --auto` with no `review_single_issue_security_pass.sh followup-guard` call. scripts/review_autofix_step_deterministic_skip_security_pass.sh:91 posts the head-gate success and line 1468 then arms `--auto` unguarded. Small follow-up PRs take this route. The editor recorded TASK_GAP_DEFERRED citing the plan grant's files_touched, but the issue defers nothing.
- requirement: "the review merge path must not merge a PR whose base is a standalone PR's head branch when that branch's current head has a status=clean security-pass marker" (the issue's "review merge path" wording covers judge-driven merges)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, review-blocked judge merge sites (lines 2467, 2469, 2571–2572, 2664–2665, 3224; also cited near head-gate success posts at lines 2570/2585, 2663/2679, 2975/3002 and 3223/3236)
  confidence=4

Judge-driven `gh pr merge` calls (for example after a [judge-fix] commit on a follow-up PR) run with no followup-guard check. The editor recorded TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, but the issue does not defer it.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:841 (vs gate line 458; tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:199) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The gate (`${SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED:-false}`, line 458) and the guard (`${SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED-}` = "false", line 841) read the switch in opposite ways. The "Enable auto-merge on PR" step and `run_security_followup_guard` (scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:272-273) do not forward it, so `reason=disabled` is unreachable. An empty string turns the gate off but leaves the guard on.
  WHY: Repos with the pass off still make the pulls, unretried `gh api user` and parent comments reads. A transient failure produces `AUTOFIX_AUTO_MERGE_HEAD_BOUND ... reason=security_followup_guard_unverifiable` and withholds auto-merge. The editor kept this as a fail-safe (known residual), and the effect is limited to lookup failures.
- TASK_GAP

  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml deterministic-skip-merge job (line 1431 `--merge --auto`, line 1468 `--squash --auto`); scripts/review_rb_judge.sh merge sites near lines 2570/2585, 2663/2679, 2975/3002 and 3223/3236.

The editor marked it TASK_GAP_DEFERRED. Report-side retirement mitigates in the meantime, but there is no tracked follow-up issue.

- HARDENING: scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh, single_pass_followup_merge_guard, `SECURITY_PASS_AUTHOR_LOGIN="$(gh api user --jq '.login // ""' 2>/dev/null || true)"`. This is the only network read without gh_retry, and SECURITY_PASS_AUTHOR_LOGIN_FALLBACK is not supplied, so a transient failure gives `unverifiable author_unverifiable`. Fix: use `gh_retry` when `type gh_retry` succeeds (~5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Cross-check: rejected openai_gpt-6-luna's MAJOR "second guard skipped when PR_CHECKS_WAIT_WAITED_S=0". pr_checks_lib.sh:711 sets 0 only when checks were already settled, and the gap between review_enable_auto_merge.sh:285 and the merge at 385/436 is a few API calls (291, 300, one checks read), no wider than the residual gap after the second guard. Confirmed the kill-switch NIT. Did not raise the phase-tag logging suggestion (log triage only). Found no defect in: the dedupe fallback `comment=unverifiable` (pipefail), the fake gh `pr_comments` branch order (tests line 84), the `None`-unset handling (tests lines 202-203), and the head-gate success left posted after a refusal (line 291), which no script uses as merge authority.
